space and then use `rm` to delete them.\\n\\nHere is a simple command to free up disk space:\\n\\n```bash\\nfind /path/to/your/directory -type f -size 10M -exec rm {} \\\\;\\n```\\n\\n### use:\\n\\n```bash\\nfind /path/to/your/directory -type d -size 10M -exec rm {} \\\\;\\n```\\n\\n### Example:\\n\\nIf you want to free up space by deleting directories in the `/home/user` directory,
